It is not a Live Activity, so Settings > Claude > Live Activities does nothing. Notifications are off, Background App Refresh is off, and it still shows up. Long-pressing just makes it bigger. There is no stop button and no setting anywhere in iOS or in the app to disable it.

I'm a mobile engineer and I'm pretty sure this is the new iOS 26 continued processing task UI, which Apple gives users no way to block. The model is great. The app is unusable for me until there's a toggle to turn this off. Deleted until that ships.
